name: HIP 76768
description: A star 0.85 solar radii and 0.8 solar masses that turns once in 3.7 days; its magnetic field has been mapped.

radius.source: Folsom et al., arXiv:1601.00684, Table 2: radius 0.85 solar radii

mass.source: Folsom et al., arXiv:1601.00684, Table 2: mass 0.8 solar masses

temperature.source: Pecaut & Mamajek (2013, ApJS 208, 9), the online table's version 2022.04.16, row K5V, for SIMBAD's spectral type K5V: Teff

spin.source: Folsom et al., arXiv:1601.00684, Table 2: rotation period 3.7 d and an axis 60 degrees from the line of sight, the values its magnetic maps were made with

text.card: A star 85% of the Sun's width that turns once in 3.7 days, with a mapped magnetic field.
text.introduction: Folsom et al. give it 0.85 solar radii, 0.8 solar masses, a rotation period of 3.7 days and an axis tilted 60° from the line of sight.

radialVelocity.source: SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 6254299662396908288 (quality A), from 2021A&A...645A..30Z; Gaia DR3 measures none
